description:
## Goal

Extend the focused App StrictMode suite from the two edge orderings to every topologically valid listener-registration completion order.

**Triage:** ready-for-agent

## Background

Each StrictMode lifecycle registers the Workspace transition listener before the Issue Explorer refresh listener (`src/App.tsx:192-216`). Therefore `R1` cannot be requested before `T1` resolves, and `R2` cannot be requested before `T2` resolves. Across the two runs, six completion orders satisfy those constraints.

The core invariant is order-independent because run 1 captures `disposed_1 === true` after cleanup and run 2 captures its separate `disposed_2 === false` while mounted. Every stale handle must unlisten; every live handle must remain; startup must come only from run 2.

This task assumes the deferred listener controller and the stale-first/live-first proofs already exist.

## Work

Use `it.each` or an equally clear parameterized structure to cover:

```text
T1 → R1 → T2 → R2
T1 → T2 → R1 → R2
T1 → T2 → R2 → R1
T2 → T1 → R1 → R2
T2 → T1 → R2 → R1
T2 → R2 → T1 → R1
```

It is fine to fold the existing stale-first and live-first tests into this matrix if each row has a descriptive name and failures report the ordering. Do not retain duplicate tests that assert the same path without adding diagnostic value.

For every row, assert after all continuations settle:

```text
live registrations: T2 and R2 only
T1 unlisten calls: 1
R1 unlisten calls: 1
T2/R2 unlisten calls before unmount: 0
startup Issue load calls: 1
startup workspace_state calls: 1
```

Also assert startup does not begin before the live refresh registration `R2` resolves. The harness must enforce actual request sequencing rather than pre-creating refresh registrations that App has not requested.

## Guardrails

- Keep the matrix readable; use typed logical registration names rather than array indexes or unexplained magic numbers.
- Do not model listeners outside App and test only the model.
- Avoid spreading setup across so many helpers that the ownership assertions become hard to follow.
- No production code or WebDriver changes are expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All six valid orders execute against the real App lifecycle.
- [ ] Invalid transition/refresh orderings are not presented as possible App behavior.
- [ ] Every row proves only `T2`/`R2` remain live before unmount.
- [ ] Every row proves stale handles unlisten once and startup reads run once.
- [ ] Failure output identifies the completion order.
- [ ] Focused tests, related App tests, and `pnpm check` pass.
title: Cover every valid StrictMode listener completion order
